card.name: Numbered figure lists and scattered spots
card.fires_on: Mostly the number in a run of repeated "Figure N" labels, where the next label is predictable. Also fires on the end of a disease name or abbreviation right before a bracketed short form or a dose.

modes.label: Figure number runs
modes.description: The digit in a repeating list of Figure 1 Figure 2 Figure 3 labels.
modes.example: Figure 1 Figure 2 Figure 3 Figure 4 Figure <<5>> Figure 6 Figure 7 Figure

modes.label: End of disease names
modes.description: The last piece of a condition name or abbreviation just before an abbreviation or dose.

modes.label: Back-reference to listed items
modes.description: A word after a phrase like "listed above" that refers back to earlier text.
modes.example: Surgery is associated with the same complications listed above<< for>> NF2-related VS.

card.writes: It promotes words meaning "above" or "aforementioned", which suggests a pull toward back-references to earlier text.
card.plain: It lights up on repeated figure numbers and at spots where text refers back to something already stated.
